featured_reviews.name: kamal bhatia
featured_reviews.review_text:
As someone from Delhi who can't compromise on food quality and taste, Jasbir Tiffin has been nothing short of a blessing. Aunty's meals are filled with love and the authentic flavours that remind me of my mom's cooking back home.

After a long, exhausting day at work that often leaves you drained, Aunty's food does more than just fill your stomach—it revives your spirit.

I salute Aunty for bringing the taste of my home to Mumbai, ensuring that no matter how far away I am, I always have a little piece of Delhi with me. Thank you, Jasbir Tiffin, for being more than just a tiffin service—you've become a part of my daily life that I deeply value and appreciate.

Highly recommended for anyone craving that home-cooked goodness! 🍽️❤️

featured_reviews.name: Satish Sudarsan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I started lunch & dinner from Jasbir Tiffin Service almost a month back because I was not happy with my Marathi cook's food.
I am extremely happy with the food being provided which is not only tasty, but homely as well.
The best part for me is the huge variety of dishes both veg and non-veg and nothing is repeated.
Fantastic food service.
Thank you Jasbirji. I am truly a fan of your cooking.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thanks for your valuable feedback! It means a lot :)

featured_reviews.name: rajan sabhani
featured_reviews.review_text: Have been getting food from Jasbir for the last week. For once it feels as though the food has been cooked in my own kitchen. Every daal has a distinctive flavour and taste and the vegetables too are cooked in minimum oil and taste really good. The best part of the meal are the awesome chapattis which are soft and fresh. I would recommend this tiffin to anyone who wants typical home cooked, hygienic food! !

featured_reviews.name: N B
featured_reviews.review_text: Food is very tasty. Mrs. Jasbir's nature is good and cordial. Punjabi food is served. Quantity and quality both r good. Reasonable price. Good service. Professional attitude.Nonoily, nonspicy healthy food. We r happy and satisfied. God bless her and her family. 👍

featured_reviews.name: Latikesh Salve
featured_reviews.review_text:
This Lady serves pathetic Food Tiffin.

1) Very Poor Quality of Rice used
2) Burnt Chapattis.
3) Vegetable and Dal completely Filled with Salt as well worst spicy masalas

Such Absurd Food she is Charging Rs200 per tiffin which she don't deserve this price at all.

***Most important point she have a tendency of forgetting things like payment made to her and tiffin served.*****

KINDLY BE CAUTIOUS BEFORE TAKING THIS TIFFIN SERVICES.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Mr. Latikesh Salve, we understand that everyone has their preferences, but there's a fine line between sharing constructive feedback and ranting. If our food didn't meet your expectations, we'd have appreciated the opportunity to address it during your subscription period (6th January 2026 to 17th February 2026). Instead, you've taken to public platforms to express your discontent.

We'd like to remind you that our team, led by a dedicated single mother, works hard to provide quality services. Reminding customers about outstanding payments is part of our process, and it's not an excuse for personal attacks.

For the record, we have a detailed order history that shows your usage and payment history. If you'd like, we can share it with you.

As for you, we hope you find peace and learn to manage your frustrations in a more constructive way. Until then, we'll focus on serving our valued customers.

Best regards,
Team Khana La Raha Hu.

featured_reviews.name: Ajeya Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Each and every item that is cooked here is really well made. One can feel there's a lot of effort made to prepare everything. Authentic home made food, rightly cooked, good balance of home made masalas, not spicy yet very tasty and decent quantity, on time delivery. A must try for anyone wanting home food.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We are glad to serve you!
Stay tuned.

featured_reviews.name: Raj Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered the Misal from South Tiffin House through

Zomato after reading a few good reviews, but it turned out to be quite disappointing. The Misal was extremely oily, and the excess oil completely overpowered the flavor of the dish. Instead of getting that nice balance of spice and tang that makes Misal enjoyable, it just tasted greasy and

heavy.

The farsan portion was another letdown. It was very little, almost like they forgot it's supposed to be an essential part of the dish. Without enough farsan, the Misal lost its crunch and texture, which made it feel incomplete. The pav was fine and the packaging was decent, but the main dish itself just didn't deliver.

I had higher expectations from South Tiffin House, especially since they're known for traditional snacks. With a few improvements, this could actually be a good Misal. If they reduce the oil and serve a more generous amount of farsan, the taste would improve a lot. Right now though, I wouldn't recommend ordering it if you're looking for an authentic, well-balanced Misal. I hope they work on this because the potential is definitely there, but the current version just misses the mark.

featured_reviews.name: Ameet Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Food: 5/5
Price: 4/5
Service: 5/5
Staff Behavior: 5/5

Yes ofcourse they really mean what they say.. Maa ke hat ka khana.
The food, packaging, hygiene everything is taken care of to the best. Like mother they remind you to order food even if you forget any day.
The main concern for many people about this kind of tiffin services is the hygiene level at food preparation place. I personally visited their kitchen and believe me it is very neat & clean. I have tried many other food services but here the food is the best as per the quality & quantity. As per the price also it is quite decent. You can subscribe for their regular meal for just INR 100/-. Other premium items may seem to be bit pricy but quality justify the price.
Thank you Team Bhojanayan for serving delicious yet healthy food to many people like me who are far from their home. Thank you for delivering me food even after placing order after 9pm which is usually your closing hours.
I wish the whole team good luck. Keep growing and expand your business to more area so that more people get your service, All the best.
